frame graph "The example: Move my blog, with five slice
frame steps "Case 1: you assign the whole tree"
step "Tap Assign tree on Move my blog"
step "The sheet says: 2 start now, 3 wait. You confirm"
step "Export posts and Set up new host start together"
step "When both reach review, Import posts starts by itself"
step "Then Fix images and Switch domain start. You did nothing in between"
step "Any attended slice still stops at its plan gate for your approve"
frame steps "Case 2: you assign one by one"
step "You open the big card and see the outline in steps"
step "Export posts and Set up new host carry the next mark: they can start now"
step "Each one says unblocks 3, so you know starting them frees the most"
step "Import posts says waits for export and host, so assigning it early does nothing yet"
step "You assign the next marked card whenever you want more running"
frame steps "Case 3: unrelated cards compete"
step "Assigned: Move my blog tree, then Fix my bank export, then Plan a trip"
step "The drain starts them in that numbered order, oldest first by default"
step "You tap Next on Fix my bank export: it jumps to number 1"
step "The whole blog tree moves as one place in the queue"
step "Next on one slice only moves it up inside its own tree"
step "Rule: a card waiting on a sibling never starts, even at number 1"
